note: P2C early cost-consequence model; per 1,000 non-dysplastic patients, 10-year horizon, 3.5% discount, NHS England 2023/24 GBP. value = observed held-out rates with base-case costs; ci95 = 2.5/97.5 percentiles over 2,000 PSA iterations, each pairing one patient-bootstrap draw of all rules' rates with one draw of every cost, transition and utility parameter. 'endos' and 'samples' undiscounted counts; costs and QALYs discounted.

c_endo.source: FE21Z diagnostic upper GI endoscopy with biopsy, day case, National Cost Collection 2023/24 (NHS England 2024; as used in HTW EAR069, Oct 2025)

c_op.source: WF01A consultant-led follow-up attendance, upper GI service, NCC 2023/24 (HTW EAR069)

c_emr.source: FE02A-C major therapeutic endoscopy, day case, NCC 2023/24 (HTW EAR069)

c_rfa.source: FE01Z complex therapeutic endoscopy, day case, NCC 2023/24 (HTW EAR069)

c_oes.source: FF02A-C oesophagectomy, elective, NCC 2023/24 (HTW EAR069 table A10)

c_chemo.source: chemotherapy 1 year, Swart 2021 / NICE NG83, inflated to 2023/24 (HTW EAR069)

c_pall.source: palliative care, final year of life (HTW EAR069)

c_review.source: expert (second) pathology review; assumption (range 44-200; 44 = round-7d NHS histopathology proxy)

prem_expert.source: expert-centre endoscopy premium as a share of FE21Z (longer slot, high-definition, referral); assumption

c_slide.source: scan + storage + QA per slide; Ardon 2023 J Pathol Inform (USD 0.55-19.53 per scan, 0.79-0.92 staff per slide), ~1-1.2 GB/slide storage

c_ai.source: AI licence and sign-off per endoscopy scored; assumption

c_backscan.source: retrieve + scan one archived slide (memory needs the prior endoscopy); assumption

seq_fail.source: sWGS failure -> repeat assay; assumption (FFPE sWGS library success ~98% in one series)

slides_per_endo.source: cohort: 9.54 samples per non-progressor over 4.65 endoscopies

p_hgd_oac.source: annual HGD -> early OAC (Swart 2021 via HTW EAR069)

p_early_late.source: annual early -> late OAC (Swart 2021 expert opinion, via HTW EAR069)

p_surg.source: late OAC suitable for surgery (Sami 2021, HTW EAR069)

p_death_postsurg.source: annual death after oesophagectomy (5-y survival 25%, Ovrebo 2012, HTW EAR069)

u_surg_y1.source: late OAC, year of surgery (HTW EAR069)

age_mult.source: general-population utility multiplier around age 70-80 (Hernandez Alava 2022 NICE DSU)

le_70.source: remaining life expectancy at about age 70, ONS national life tables (approx.)

lam.source: NICE threshold GBP per QALY (lower end)

break_even_note: breakeven_seq_price: GBP per sample at which the strategy's incremental cost vs the reference is 0 (cost only) or its NMB at GBP 20k/QALY is 0 (the strategy is preferred BELOW it when seq_slope > 0; a negative value means it is cheaper at any price only if the slope is negative, i.e. it sequences less than the reference); breakeven_flag_cost: GBP per AI flag at which incremental cost is 0 (preferred BELOW it when flag_slope > 0); miss_value_threshold: value of one de-escalated progressor (discounted cost + GBP 20k x QALY) above which the strategy stops being preferred (NMB < 0) at GBP 250 per sample

assumptions.derivation: UK primary-care incidence of diagnosed Barrett's 15.6-85.6 per 100,000 person-years at ages 40-74 (Masclee et al. 2014, about 22 per 100,000 per year across all ages) x about 11-12 years under surveillance = about 0.25% of the population; uptake 100% of eligible NDBE on expert read
assumptions.annualisation: discounted 10-year incremental cost per 1,000 / 10 x patients / 1,000 (approximate; undiscounted spend is about 15% higher)

setup_one_off_gbp.note: scanner capital 'upwards of GBP 100,000' (vendor guidance); LIS / integration ~GBP 15,000 (unverified vendor figure); only for services without digital pathology
